metas.name: Arrival
metas.description: Like Ex Machina and The Artifice Girl, this is an intellectually stimulating and highly atmospheric sci-fi drama that values ideas, language, and emotional depth over cheap action.

metas.name: No Country for Old Men
metas.description: Matches the gritty, high-stakes intensity and moral complexity found in Sicario and Gran Torino, featuring exceptional performances and relentless suspense.

metas.name: The Witch
metas.description: A deeply atmospheric, period-accurate horror film that captures the same slow-burning dread, psychological isolation, and supernatural mystery as The Others.

metas.name: Prisoners
metas.description: Directed by Denis Villeneuve (Sicario), this intense and dark mystery thriller shares Gone Girl's emotional complexity and gripping, morally gray investigations.

metas.name: Zodiac
metas.description: For fans of Conclave and Gone Girl, this meticulously detailed thriller focuses on obsession and procedural investigation, demanding the audience's full attention.

metas.name: Nightcrawler
metas.description: A dark, cynical character study with high psychological stakes that will appeal to fans of intense thrillers like Gone Girl and the gritty realism of Sicario.

metas.name: Her
metas.description: If you appreciated the philosophical exploration of artificial intelligence and human connection in Ex Machina, this film offers a softer but equally profound take.

metas.name: Coherence
metas.description: A brilliant low-budget sci-fi thriller that relies entirely on sharp dialogue, mounting paranoia, and a complex puzzle-box narrative, perfect for fans of Exam.

metas.name: A Quiet Place
metas.description: An intensely stressful sci-fi horror film that uses sound design to construct unbearable tension, appealing to fans of 28 Days Later and The Abyss.

metas.name: Get Out
metas.description: This modern horror thriller blends social commentary with mystery, keeping viewers on the edge of their seats much like Smile 2 and Gone Girl.

metas.name: The Lighthouse
metas.description: A claustrophobic, intense, and psychologically unhinged drama starring Willem Dafoe and Robert Pattinson, mirroring the uncompromising prestige tone of The Master.

metas.name: Children of Men
metas.description: A gritty, high-stakes masterpiece of science fiction that captures the visceral survival element of 28 Days Later and the geopolitical urgency of The Hurt Locker.

metas.name: Shutter Island
metas.description: This psychological mystery directed by Martin Scorsese offers the same gothic atmosphere, unreliable narration, and twisting reality as The Others.

metas.name: The Banshees of Inisherin
metas.description: Reuniting the writer-director and stars of In Bruges, this dark, melancholic comedy-drama delivers sharp dialogue and deep emotional stakes.

metas.name: The Invitation
metas.description: A masterclass in slow-burn tension, this chamber thriller relies on social awkwardness and mounting paranoia, appealing directly to fans of Exam and It's What's Inside.

metas.name: There Will Be Blood
metas.description: Directed by Paul Thomas Anderson (The Master), this epic prestige drama features a powerhouse performance and an uncompromising, dark exploration of greed.

metas.name: Annihilation
metas.description: Written and directed by Alex Garland (Ex Machina), this surreal, disturbing sci-fi horror film combines high-concept ideas with terrifying creature design.

metas.name: 10 Cloverfield Lane
metas.description: A highly intense, claustrophobic thriller that thrives on the psychological power struggle between its characters, matching the vibe of Exam.

metas.name: The Prestige
metas.description: A complex, dark, and beautifully acted mystery thriller about obsession and rivalry that demands careful attention, much like Gone Girl.

metas.name: Upgrade
metas.description: A thrilling, dark sci-fi action movie dealing with cybernetic enhancement and artificial intelligence control, hitting the sweet spot between Ex Machina and gritty pulp.

metas.name: Black Swan
metas.description: This psychological horror-thriller captures the intense psychological breakdown, musical performance anxiety, and hallucinated dread found in Smile 2.

metas.name: Midsommar
metas.description: An unsettling, beautifully shot daylight horror film that explores grief and cult dynamics, aligning with the prestige terror of The Others and Conclave.

metas.name: Se7en
metas.description: A benchmark for gritty crime thrillers, this film's oppressive atmosphere, dark themes, and shocking twists make it a perfect match for fans of Gone Girl and Sicario.

metas.name: Oldboy
metas.description: A masterpiece of psychological revenge and mystery. Its sheer intensity, dark twists, and incredible craftsmanship will appeal to viewers who love uncompromising thrillers.

metas.name: Burning
metas.description: A slow-burn South Korean masterpiece of psychological tension and ambiguity, mirroring the artistic weight of The Master and the mystery of Gone Girl.

metas.name: First Reformed
metas.description: Like Conclave and The Master, this film is a quiet, intense study of faith, existential dread, and radicalization, driven by an exceptional lead performance.

metas.name: The Menu
metas.description: A sharp, satirical thriller that combines dark comedy with high stakes and hostage dynamics, making it an excellent companion to It's What's Inside and In Bruges.

metas.name: Grave of the Fireflies
metas.description: For a viewer who appreciates the historical and artistic weight of Ghibli films like The Wind Rises, this devastating war drama is an essential masterwork.

metas.name: Perfect Blue
metas.description: An intense, animated psychological thriller about identity loss and obsession that heavily influenced modern horror, appealing to fans of Smile 2.

metas.name: Decision to Leave
metas.description: A gorgeous, intricate romantic mystery thriller from Park Chan-wook that features the same elegant tension and deceptive characters as Gone Girl.

metas.name: The Game
metas.description: A thrilling David Fincher classic that keeps both the protagonist and the audience guessing until the very end, ideal for fans of puzzle-box films like Exam.

metas.name: Parasite
metas.description: A razor-sharp, genre-bending dark comedy thriller with incredible social commentary that perfectly appeals to fans of In Bruges and Gone Girl.

metas.name: Incendies
metas.description: An emotionally devastating mystery drama from Denis Villeneuve (Sicario) that features a stunning historical and personal quest with high stakes.

metas.name: Spotlight
metas.description: An engaging, procedural, and dialogue-heavy prestige drama that, like Conclave, treats serious subject matter with intelligence, respect, and quiet tension.

metas.name: Drive
metas.description: A highly stylized, quiet, yet incredibly violent neo-noir thriller that captures the moody atmospheric depth of Sicario and the gritty code of Gran Torino.

metas.name: The Babadook
metas.description: A critically acclaimed horror movie that uses its monster as a metaphor for grief and trauma, delivering the psychological depth of The Others.

metas.name: The Killing of a Sacred Deer
metas.description: An unsettling, deadpan psychological thriller with mythological undertones. Its sterile atmosphere and mounting dread match the unique tone of The Master.

metas.name: Primer
metas.description: An uncompromisingly complex sci-fi thriller that demands absolute focus, matching the high-concept intellectual puzzle-solving of The Artifice Girl.

metas.name: Sunshine
metas.description: Directed by Danny Boyle and written by Alex Garland (the duo behind 28 Days Later), this is a stunning, high-stakes sci-fi thriller set in deep space.

metas.name: The Conversation
metas.description: A classic, slow-burn thriller centering on surveillance, paranoia, and moral guilt that shares a thoughtful, atmospheric approach with Conclave.
